summary: Mathematics teacher for 9 years who moved into UX research and design through the Google UX Design Certificate. I have run interviews and usability tests for two volunteer projects and want to join a product team as a junior UX researcher.
skills: interviews, usability testing, surveys, affinity mapping
wireframes and prototypes in Figma, user flows
explaining complex ideas simply, running workshops, giving feedback
tools: Figma, FigJam, Google Forms, Google Sheets, Miro, Notion, SQL

experience.title: Senior Teacher, Mathematics
bullets: Teach mathematics to 4 sections of Class 9 and 10, about 160 students a year.
Ran a survey of 220 parents and students on online homework and used the results to change the homework format; late submissions fell from 30% to 12%.
Trained 14 teachers on Google Classroom during the 2020 lockdown.

portfolio.name: Clinic booking redesign (volunteer, Arogya Trust)
bullets: Interviewed 8 patients and 3 front-desk staff about booking appointments by phone.
Built a Figma prototype for SMS booking and ran 6 usability tests; task success rose from 3 of 6 to 6 of 6 after two rounds of changes.

portfolio.name: Library app usability study (Google UX Design Certificate)
bullets: Wrote a test plan, ran 5 moderated tests and grouped findings in an affinity map in FigJam.
Turned the top 4 findings into design changes and a short report for the course review.
